repository_dossiers.primary_algorithm: Deterministic factor-model scoring and ranking with confidence, calibration, and independent fair-value estimators. The repository's prediction-engine exports scoring, game-context factors, edge assessment, ranking probability, settlement, CLV, Poisson, Skellam, Elo, PowerIndex, standings-strength, NFL EPA, and calibration utilities.
repository_dossiers.license: NOT CONFIRMED. The fetched repository page and attempted /blob/main/LICENSE page did not expose a license file or license declaration.
repository_dossiers.reusable_logic: Pure TypeScript scoring and odds utilities; Game-context factor functions; Edge and ranking probability interfaces; Settlement and historical no-lookahead replay exports; CLV capture and grading exports; Independent model helpers including Poisson, Skellam, Elo, PowerIndex, standings strength, NFL EPA, and Dixon-Coles; Calibration and reliability diagnostics; Proof-of-record, slate commitment, and pick proof receipt primitives
repository_dossiers.integration_effort: Medium to high. Reusable pure TypeScript prediction logic is substantial, but a production integration needs normalized source adapters, point-in-time features, server-side entitlements, settlement and calibration data, and careful gating because multiple advanced modules are explicitly not live or founder-gated. This effort rating is an analyst estimate, not a GitHub claim.

gse_build_items.engineer_days: Estimate: 4-8 engineer-days for a narrow adapter and contract tests; not sourced from GitHub.
gse_build_items.impact: Adopt or port a deterministic scoring core with odds conversion, vig removal, factor context, confidence, ranking, and settlement interfaces.
